fields.breadcrumb-text-2: How can you use artificial intelligence to predict your sales?
fields.title-post: How can you use artificial intelligence to predict your sales?
fields.rt-blog-html:
Sales forecasting for a restaurant involves estimating future sales volume based on historical data and external factors. In the restaurant industry, this process is essential for anticipating demand, adjusting inventory levels, organizing staff, and optimizing profitability.

Long done intuitively or using spreadsheets, restaurant sales forecasting is now undergoing a transformation thanks to artificial intelligence.

In this guide, learn why forecasting has become a strategic priority, how AI-powered sales forecasting works, and which tools can help you more effectively predict a restaurant’s business.

‍

Why is sales forecasting strategic for your restaurant?

Even before a business opens, sales forecasting is a key component of financial management.

The Hidden Costs of Poor Sales Forecasting

Inaccurate restaurant sales forecasts can directly impact profitability.

When sales volumes are miscalculated, teams may be overstaffed, which increases labor costs. Conversely, understaffing can slow down service and negatively impact the customer experience.

Inventory management is also affected: food waste, product shortages, or excessive tying up of cash.

👉 Learn more: Food Cost: 5 Ways to Effectively Reduce It

Expected sales fluctuations in the fast-food industry

Business volume can fluctuate depending on several external factors: weather, local events, holidays, or changes in work habits.

A change in the weather can lead to an increase in delivery orders, while a local event can cause a surge in foot traffic.

In this context, the use of a predictive tool capable of analyzing these variations becomes a real operational advantage.

The ROI of Reliable Sales Forecasting

Effective forecasting helps optimize supplier orders, plan staff schedules, and minimize losses from food waste.

According to a study by INSEE, organizations that leverage their data improve their operational efficiency.

‍

How does sales forecasting work with artificial intelligence?

Predictive analytics solutionsfor restaurants use artificial intelligence to analyze large amounts of data and identify trends that are difficult to detect manually.

The data needed for a reliable forecast

Quality depends on the data used.

Sales forecasting software analyzes sales history, peak hours, product performance, seasonal trends, and sales channels.

The more data there is and the better it is structured, the more reliable predictive analysis becomes.

Machine learning algorithms applied to the restaurant industry

Predictive analytics tools rely on machine learning algorithms capable of learning from historical data.

These models identify recurring patterns such as weekly peaks in activity, seasonal variations, or customer purchasing behavior.

The reliability of forecasts: What can we actually expect?

Thanks to artificial intelligence, restaurant owners can obtain highly accurate analytics.

Some predictive analytics solutions, such as those offered by Fullsoon, claim accuracy rates of up to 95%, enabling more effective forecasting of demand fluctuations. 

👉 To go further: Food service: how artificial intelligence improves your profitability

‍

What tools should be used for sales forecasting in the restaurant industry?

As technology evolves, spreadsheet-based methods are gradually being replaced by more powerful solutions.

The limitations of manual methods

These methods are time-consuming, prone to errors, and take few variables into account.

In contrast, AI-based solutions can automatically analyze thousands of data points in just a few seconds.

Criteria for selecting sales forecasting software

Restaurant sales forecasting software should centralize restaurant sales data, analyze restaurant performance metrics, and provide actionable insights.

User-friendliness and ease of use are also essential so that teams can use these tools on a daily basis without any hassle.

Atlas developed by Innovorder

Among the industry’s innovative solutions, Atlas—developed by Innovorder—offers a different approach to data management.

Atlas is an AI-native platform designed to turn data into immediately actionable decisions. Unlike traditional reporting tools, Atlas analyzes data and provides operational recommendations.

The platform centralizes data on sales, foot traffic, products, and channels to provide a comprehensive overview of the business.

"It's not just data. It's data analyzed and backed by an action plan." Thierry Veil, co-founder of Bagelstein

👉 Read more: 5 restaurants using artificial intelligence to improve their performance

How can you implement sales forecasting in your restaurant?

Establishing an effective " " forecast requires a structured approach.

Step 1: Collect and consolidate your sales data

Ticket history, product performance, time-based or seasonal variations.

Step 2: Set up your forecasting tool (or try Atlas)

Once the data has been structured, a predictive analytics tool can be used to identify trends and anticipate changes in business activity.

Step 3: Put Forecasts to Use in Your Daily Work

These analyses make it possible to adjust supplier orders, determine team sizes, and optimize inventory management.

Step 4: Continuously measure and optimize

It is essential to regularly monitor performance metrics in order to improve analyses and refine operational decisions.

👉 To go further: Reduce errors in catering with automatic detection

--

In an industry characterized by fluctuations in foot traffic and sometimes tight margins, analyzing data and anticipating trends enables better decision-making.

Thanks to predictive analytics solutions and AI-powered platforms like Atlas, restaurant owners can now turn their data into concrete actions.
